sources.entry: RightMenu Master - Add more useful actions to the Finder right-click menu. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/rightmenu-master/6737160756?platform=mac)

summary.name: Menuist
summary.one_liner: Menuist (formerly RightMenu Master) is a macOS Finder extension that adds file actions to the right-click menu and quick folder navigation to the menu bar.
use_cases: Add file actions like copy path or move to Finder right-click menu
Create new files from the Finder context menu
Open favorite or recent folders from the menu bar
Preview code files with syntax highlighting
Share files via QR code on the local network
Convert image formats or create icns icons from Finder
summary.what_it_does: Menuist is a configurable Finder extension that adds actions to the right-click menu and toolbar, such as creating new files, copying file paths and names, cutting and pasting, moving or copying files to set locations, and direct deletion. It provides a menu bar item for quick access to favorite folders, frequently used locations, folder access history, and external drives. Additional features include QuickLook previews for apps and code, image format conversion, icns icon creation, folder icon color changes, total size display for selected items, and a Git remote URL opener. The page says the app requires macOS 14.0 and that the name changed from RightMenu Master to Menuist starting with version 3.0.
notable: Finder right-click menu and toolbar extension with many file actions
Menu bar quick access to favorite, recent, and external-drive folders
QuickLook previews for apps, code with syntax highlighting, and Icon Composer .icon files
Available on the Mac App Store; formerly named RightMenu Master
caveats: Finder extension needs folder authorization; Full Disk Access alone does not solve permission prompts, and App Store sandbox rules limit a fix
On some macOS 15 versions the extension may need to be enabled via a terminal command (fixed in macOS 15.2)
